experiment_data.hypothesis: MF5 Late-Layer-First baseline: synthetic importance scores (L0-9=1.0, L10-17=0.5, L18-27=0.001) → standard prune 20% → SFT → GRPO 100 steps → eval. Tests if CKA-only advantage is confounded by layer-depth bias. If depth-first ≈ CKA-only, the advantage is just removing deep layers, not CKA-guided selection.
